backend_role_assignment.description: Backend code for assigning bulk buyer role and updating user status
backend_role_assignment.python:
@app.route('/api/v1/users/<int:user_id>/roles', methods=['POST'])
@login_required
@role_required('role.assign')
def api_assign_role_to_user(user_id):
    # ... existing validation code ...
    
    # Assign role
    target_user.assign_role(role, current_user.id, scope)
    
    # Update bulk buyer status based on roles
    bulk_buyer_changed = update_user_bulk_buyer_status(target_user)
    
    # Create notification for the user
    create_role_change_notification(target_user, role.name, 'assigned', current_user.full_name)
    
    # Log audit with bulk buyer status change
    log_audit(
        action='assign_role',
        target_type='user',
        target_id=user_id,
        details={
            'role_slug': role_slug,
            'role_name': role.name,
            'scope': scope,
            'target_username': target_user.username,
            'audit_reason': audit_reason,
            'bulk_buyer_status_changed': bulk_buyer_changed,
            'new_bulk_buyer_status': target_user.is_bulk_buyer
        },
        request_id=request_id
    )
    
    db.session.commit()
    return create_standard_response(success=True, message="Role assigned successfully")
